title: Legends & Lattes
author: Travis Baldree
summary: A tired orc mercenary retires from adventuring to open the first coffee shop in a city that has never heard of coffee. The real work is building a place, and a circle of friends, that feels like home.
readIf: You are burnt out and want a story where the biggest battle is getting the espresso machine right.
skipIf: You need high stakes, a fast plot or a villain to keep you reading.

pairings.reason: Same warmth and found-family feeling, with a touch more whimsy and a gentle romance.
A classic fantasy of comfort and good company, with a little more adventure on the road.
